desc:
Welcome to BONDY: AMBA, a public transport game inspired by the streets, buses, and routes of the Greater Buenos Aires area.

Get behind the wheel, drive around the city, transport passengers, and earn money and experience while leveling up.

WHAT CAN YOU DO?

- Drive public transport inspired by real models.
- Travel along different lines and branches.
- Earn money and level up.
- Travel as a passenger and explore the city.
- Enjoy a dynamic weather system.

GAME IN DEVELOPMENT

BONDY: AMBA is still under development, so errors or incomplete systems may appear.

We are working on new fleets, routes, performance improvements, private companies, and unit customization.

Did you find a bug?

Report it through our community tickets.

Thank you for joining us and being part of the project.

BONDY Studios
